Equation 7.2:
\mu_{d}=k_{d} \cdot\frac{[LAC]}{KD_{\mathrm{lac}}+[LAC]}\cdot\frac{[AMM]}{KD_{\mathrm{amm}}+[AMM]}

Symbols (as printed -> plain name to use):
  \mu_{d}  ->  mud   (Specific cell death rate)
  [AMM]  ->  AMM   (ammonia concentration)
  [LAC]  ->  LAC   (lactate concentration)
  KD_{amm}  ->  KDamm   (Half-maximum-rate concentration of ammonia for cell death rate)
  KD_{lac}  ->  KDlac   (Half-maximum-rate concentration of lactate for cell death rate)
  k_{d}  ->  kd   (Maximum cell death rate)
